infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: When you enable live location for an approved business, DiningDealz uses your location to keep that business pin updated while the app is closed.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: When you enable live location for an approved business, DiningDealz uses your location to keep that business pin updated while the app is closed.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: DiningDealz uses your location to show nearby places and, when enabled for an approved business, update its live map location.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: DiningDealz uses your photo library so you can add business photos and attach images to messages.
